data.name: Lamond
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'hlaf-monde', meaning 'protector of the loaf'. In Anglo-Saxon society, the loaf represented the community and its welfare. The name Lamond was given to those who protected and provided for their community.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection and care for loved ones.
data.numerology_meaning: Persons with a life path number 6 are nurturing, loving, and caring individuals. They are able to provide comfort and support to those around them.

in_greek.name: Λάμονδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λάμονδ (Lamond) προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη Λάμπος (Lampas) - 'φως' (Phos), 'Λάμπος' (Lampas) - 'φωτισμός' (Photismos). Η λέξη Λάμπος (Lampas) έχει την απαρχή από το ρήμα Λάμπω (Lambo) - 'φωτίζω' (Photizo).

in_latin.name: Lamond
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lamond a radicibus Lumen - 'lux', Lamina - 'lamina', Laminum - 'lamina' derivatur. Nomen Lamond significat 'luminaria', 'lamina lumen', 'lamina lucis'.

in_english.meaning: Variant form of Lamon, derived from Lamond possibly meaning 'strong as a lion' or 'courageous warrior'.

In Christian tradition, Lamond is considered a strong and courageous name, symbolizing faith and perseverance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lamond has its roots in Old English culture and signifies someone who was a guardian and provider for their community. It is a name that speaks to the importance of family, community, and protection in Old English society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lamond can be seen as a reminder of our role as protectors and providers within our families and communities. It highlights the importance of selflessness, generosity, and compassion in caring for those around us and ensuring their wellbeing. Additionally, it can be seen as a reflection of God’s protective nature towards us and His provision for our needs.
